name: Continuous
ext_on
result.signature: [T2Space X] {s : Set Y} (hs : Dense s) {f g : Y → X} (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) (h : EqOn f g s) : f = g
result.type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space X] {s : Set Y},
  Dense s → ∀ {f g : Y → X}, Continuous f → Continuous g → Set.EqOn f g s → f = g
result.value:
:=
  funext fun x => h.closure hf hg (hs x)
result.informal_name: Continuous Functions Agreeing on a Dense Set in a Hausdorff Space are Equal
result.informal_description: Let $ X $ be a Hausdorff topological space and $ s \subseteq Y $ a dense subset. If $ f, g : Y \to X $ are continuous functions satisfying $ f(x) = g(x) $ for all $ x \in s $, then $ f = g $.

name: ContinuousMap
injective_restrict
result.signature: [T2Space β] {s : Set α} (hs : Dense s) : Injective (restrict s : C(α, β) → C(s, β))
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] [T2Space β] {s : Set α},
  Dense s → Function.Injective (ContinuousMap.restrict s)
result.value:
:= fun f g h ↦
  DFunLike.ext' <|
    (map_continuous f).ext_on hs (map_continuous g) <| Set.restrict_eq_restrict_iff.1 <| congr_arg DFunLike.coe h
result.informal_name: Injectivity of Continuous Function Restriction on Dense Subsets in Hausdorff Spaces
result.informal_description: If $\beta$ is a Hausdorff topological space and $s \subseteq \alpha$ is a dense subset, then the restriction map $C(\alpha, \beta) \to C(s, \beta)$ is injective. In other words, two continuous functions $f,g : \alpha \to \beta$ that agree on the dense subset $s$ must be equal when $\beta$ is Hausdorff.

name: Dense
extend_unique
result.signature: [T2Space β] {g : α → β} (hs : Dense s) (hf : ∀ x : s, g x = f x) (hg : Continuous g) : hs.extend f = g
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {s : Set α} {f : ↑s → β}
  [T2Space β] {g : α → β} (hs : Dense s), (∀ (x : ↑s), g ↑x = f x) → Continuous g → hs.extend f = g
result.informal_name: Uniqueness of Continuous Extension from a Dense Subset in a Hausdorff Space
result.informal_description: Let $ s $ be a dense subset of a topological space $ \alpha $, and let $ \beta $ be a Hausdorff space. If $ f : s \to \beta $ is a function and $ g : \alpha \to \beta $ is a continuous function satisfying $ g(x) = f(x) $ for all $ x \in s $, then the unique continuous extension of $ f $ to $ \alpha $ coincides with $ g $.

name: HasDerivAt
conj_conj
result.signature: {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} {f' : 𝕜} (hf : HasDerivAt f f' x) : HasDerivAt (conj ∘ f ∘ conj) (conj f') (conj x)
result.informal_description: If a function $ f $ has derivative $ f' $ at a point $ x $ in a nontrivially normed field $ \mathbb{K} $, then the function obtained by conjugating the input, applying $ f $, and conjugating the output has derivative $ \overline{f'} $ at the conjugate of $ x $. Formally, if $ f $ is differentiable at $ x $ with derivative $ f' $, then $ \overline{f(\overline{z})} $ is differentiable at $ \overline{x} $ with derivative $ \overline{f'} $.

name: HasDerivAt
star_conj
result.signature: {f : 𝕜 → F} {f' : F} (hf : HasDerivAt f f' x) : HasDerivAt (star ∘ f ∘ conj) (star f') (conj x)
result.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : StarRing 𝕜] {F : Type v} [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [inst_3 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [inst_4 : StarAddMonoid F] [StarModule 𝕜 F] [ContinuousStar F] {x : 𝕜} [NormedStarGroup 𝕜]
  {f : 𝕜 → F} {f' : F}, HasDerivAt f f' x → HasDerivAt (star ∘ f ∘ ⇑(starRingEnd 𝕜)) (star f') ((starRingEnd 𝕜) x)
result.value:
:= by
  rw [hasDerivAt_iff_hasFDerivAt]
  convert hf.hasFDerivAt.star_star
  ext
  simp
result.informal_description: If a function $ f $ has derivative $ f' $ at $ x $, then the composition $ \star \circ f \circ \text{conj} $ has derivative $ \star(f') $ at $ \text{conj}(x) $. Here, $ \star $ denotes the involution operation on the star ring and $ \text{conj} $ denotes the field conjugation.

name: DifferentiableAt
conj_conj
result.signature: {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x) : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (conj ∘ f ∘ conj) (conj x)
result.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : StarRing 𝕜] {x : 𝕜} [NormedStarGroup 𝕜] {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜},
  DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x → DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (⇑(starRingEnd 𝕜) ∘ f ∘ ⇑(starRingEnd 𝕜)) ((starRingEnd 𝕜) x)
result.informal_description: If a function $ f $ is differentiable at a point $ x $ in a nontrivially normed field $ \mathbb{K} $ equipped with an involution $ * $, then the function $ z \mapsto (f(z^*))^* $ is differentiable at $ x^* $.
